source: NPTEL Week 3 assessment, Jul–Oct 2026 run (accepted answers, reworded)

questions.question: What makes transformers far more parallelisable than RNNs?
questions.explanation: Without h_t depending on h_(t−1), all positions are computed at once.

questions.question: How does masked language modelling let BERT learn bidirectional context?
options: It predicts only the next word
It predicts randomly hidden tokens using both left and right context
It trains only on short sentences
questions.explanation: ~15% of tokens are masked and predicted from both sides.

questions.question: The [CLS] token in BERT:
options: Represents the whole sequence for classification tasks
questions.explanation: Its final hidden state feeds the classifier. [SEP] marks boundaries.

questions.question: Why do models like BERT use WordPiece tokenization?
options: It guarantees every word is in the dictionary
It builds its subword vocabulary by likelihood optimisation
questions.explanation: WordPiece merges the pieces that most increase the training-data likelihood (BPE merges by frequency).

questions.question: Which property lets GPT generate text?
questions.explanation: Each token sees only earlier tokens, so it can predict the next one.

questions.question: In ULMFiT, which stage adapts the language model to the target domain?
questions.explanation: ULMFiT: (1) general LM pre-training, (2) target-task LM fine-tuning on domain text, (3) classifier fine-tuning. Discriminative learning rates are a technique used inside stage 2, not the stage itself.

questions.question: The feed-forward network inside each transformer block:
options: Adds non-linearity and transforms each token's representation
questions.explanation: Same two-layer MLP applied to every position.

questions.question: Which component passes information from the encoder to the decoder?
questions.explanation: Decoder queries attend to encoder keys and values.

questions.question: Why is the dot product divided by √d_k in scaled attention?
options: To keep gradients stable when the key dimension is large
questions.explanation: Large dot products saturate softmax and shrink gradients.

questions.question: How do ELMo's contextual embeddings differ from Word2Vec's?
options: They depend on the whole sentence context
questions.explanation: ELMo uses a bidirectional LSTM over the sentence, so "bank" gets different vectors.
